name: Florida
seasonNote: Drop into Florida in the depths of winter, when the peninsula is at its warmest and driest — the theme parks, the beaches, and the Everglades are all at their best — and loop the state before crossing the panhandle into Alabama.
summary: The Sunshine State as one clean loop: the oldest city at St. Augustine, the theme-park capital at Orlando, the Gold Coast and Miami down the east coast, the Everglades and the Keys at the tip, the genteel Gulf beaches and Tampa Bay coming back up, and the capital and Emerald Coast across the panhandle.
